summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the NEW banner slider feature. All 12 features tested successfully. Storefront banner slider displays 3 mock banners with left/right arrow navigation and dot indicators. Arrow navigation cycles through all banners correctly with wrap-around. Active dot indicator is visually wider than inactive dots. Dashboard Settings tab shows 'Manage Banners' section with existing banner thumbnails, Add Banner button, and delete button on hover. Deleting a banner removes it from the list with success toast. Previously working features (category-grouped product display, checkout flow) still work correctly.
passed_tests: Storefront page (/shop/the-elite-shop) displays a big banner slider above the product sections with 3 mock banners
Banner slider has left/right arrow buttons for navigation between slides (data-testid='banner-prev'/'banner-next')
Banner slider has dot indicators at the bottom — clicking dots navigates to the correct slide (data-testid='banner-dot-0/1/2')
Arrow navigation cycles through all 3 banners correctly (left goes to previous, right goes to next, wraps around)
Active dot indicator visually differs from inactive dots (wider w-6 class vs w-2.5)
Shop Owner Dashboard Settings tab shows 'Manage Banners' section (Quản lý Banner in Vietnamese)
Dashboard banner section displays existing banner thumbnails in a grid (data-testid='banner-list')
Dashboard banner section has 'Add Banner' upload button (data-testid='add-banner-btn')
Dashboard banner items show delete button on hover (data-testid='delete-banner-{id}')
Deleting a banner removes it from the list with success toast ('Đã xóa banner')
Previously working: category-grouped product display on storefront still works
Previously working: checkout flow still works on storefront (add to cart → checkout → thank you page)
known_limitations: Adding a banner via upload is MOCKED - the mock endpoint returns a random picsum URL instead of actually uploading
Mock data changes (banners, orders) are stored in memory and reset when page reloads
critical_code_review_comments: Banner slider implementation uses opacity transitions for smooth slide changes
Banner navigation state (currentSlide) is properly managed with useState
Wrap-around logic correctly implemented: prevSlide uses (prev === 0 ? banners.length - 1 : prev - 1), nextSlide uses (prev === banners.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1)
Dashboard banner management properly integrates with mock API endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE /dashboard/banners)
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
